title: Modifiers
html:
Item names are not random flavor. Each extra word is a modifier you can read.

A typical yellow sword looks like:

Molten Iron Sword of the Beetle
  • Molten — Magic prefix (blue word in front)
  • Iron Sword — the base item
  • of the — the glue word
  • Beetle — Superior last word (green+). Beetle on fighter armor is always Endurance.

Yellow adds another word before that last word. Purple swaps the front word for a Unique prefix. Grey junk can also wear a cosmetic level word (Opaque, Acid-Wash) that does not change stats. Rainbows keep a fixed name and can roll a joke ending instead.

When the words show up

  • Grey (Normal) — cosmetic level prefix only
  • Green (Superior, level 1+) — last word
  • Blue (Magic, level 3+) — prefix + last word
  • Yellow (Rare, level 6+) — prefix + rare postfix + last word
  • Purple (Unique, level 10+) — unique prefix + rare postfix + last word
  • Rainbow (Mythic, level 15+) — fixed name, optional mythic ending

Full word lists

  • Name Descriptors — Superior last words by class and weapon
  • Level Prefixes — grey cosmetic words
  • Magic Prefixes — blue words in front
  • Rare Postfixes — yellow words after the name
  • Unique Prefixes — purple words in front
  • Mythic Suffixes — rainbow joke endings
  • Item Prefixes — every front-of-name list
  • Item Suffixes — every after-the-name list

Fighter loot uses Scale / Plate / Crystal. Ranger uses Leather / Chain / Splint. Mage uses Ghost / Cloth / Padded. Anyone can wear any piece that meets the level.
